sentences.text: Researchers created a library of 23 different chemical compounds based on alpha-lipoic acid, identifying one specific compound, D14, which showed a massive improvement in stopping iron-related cell death compared to the original drug while maintaining its ability to fight inflammation. Computational analysis found that D14 works by cleaning up harmful free radicals and boosting a specific internal pathway to protect cells from dying.

The compound also blocked a signaling chain that triggers inflammation and lowered the release of specific inflammatory proteins. When tested on rats with induced strokes, the new compound reduced brain damage and improved behavior better than the original drug and an existing medical treatment, and early safety checks suggested that the compound does not appear to be highly toxic.
The authors conclude that this specific molecule is a strong candidate for developing new stroke treatments.
